title: 第1285章 一个一个敲打第1284章 魔剑邀战
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
第1285章一个一个敲打
一个李元，一个剑仙子，再加一个沉娘子。
现在的无疆仙宗足足有三大至高战力，比天庭都要略胜一筹，更别说还有一个潜力十足，以轮回证道，改变了大世格局的的孟姜。
未来孟姜再入至高，便是一门四大至高，谁与争锋？
缥缈仙殿没落，是被无疆仙宗踩着脑袋没落的，再耻辱也只能受着。
“好！我们让！”
最终，飞剑无良开口。
李元目光转动，又看向万界宫所在。
“你们呢？”
万界宫十二圣柱眉头紧皱，这是要把所有超然势力全部踩一遍吗？
就不怕各方联合起来打杀了无疆仙宗？
他们无法奈何李元，但大战一起，无疆仙宗绝对撑不住的，除了李元、剑仙子恐怕都得死。
甚至会让太初界生灵涂炭，再次给混沌神魔可乘之机。
李元就这么不顾后果？
可是……
没人敢和李元赌，也没有人愿意赌一个疯子会不会鱼死网破。
更别说李元身上发生过太多意外，谁也不知道还会不会有下一个无法预料的东西等着他们。
“曾经吾靠一双铁拳，硬生生在太初界杀出一条路，建立唯一没有仙尊传承背景的超然。”
“世人皆说，我占了天时地利人和，太初格局既定，再无人能够复刻我的奇迹之路。”
“李元，你做到了。”

“你不仅做到了，还做的比我更好。”
万界宫大宫主，阳柱阳无敌忽地大笑。
“一座超大型仙州而已，我们让给你，赢者得，败者失，我们认了！”
其实六大超然早已权衡利弊。
永生种之争已经尘埃落定，未来的路基本已成定数，超大型仙州的重要性远不如从前了。
过去时代，六大超然都要靠超大型仙州来维续壮大，笼络诸多修行资源。
也是靠超然势力的庞大，无数的后辈以及众生气运的运转来维持心灵意识的腐朽减缓。
如今，这些都不重要了。
待李元成尊，纪元就会迎来大毁灭的倒计时。
到时候一切都是虚妄，有一座超大型仙州来维持他们的自封沉睡就够了，反正睡到下一个纪元的几率也是微乎其微。
“好。”
李元则是毫不客气。
他要多座超大型仙州，只有一个目的，那就是聚拢众生气运，感知大世界本源。
接下来他的计划只有一个。
那就是让太初界连通生死界和天源大陆，这是最关键的一步，关系到大世能否被真正补全。
李元目光再次转移，这次对准了鸿蒙灵族。
鸿蒙灵族的诸位绝巅大修齐齐色变。
要知道整个鸿蒙灵族也就占据了两座超大型仙州，却蕴养着无数种族，本就狼多肉少。
再让出去一座？
那鸿蒙灵族真的要枯竭了。

“你们也是一座。”
李元目光如火，丝毫不给情面，直接向着鸿蒙灵族开口。
“李元尊者，非要逼迫我们吗？”
content_en:
Chapter 1285 Beating one by one
One Li Yuan, one Sword Fairy, and another Lady Shen.
The current Wujiang Immortal Sect has three supreme combat powers, which are slightly better than those of Heavenly Court, not to mention Meng Jiang, who is full of potential and has changed the pattern of the world through reincarnation.
In the future, when Meng Jiang becomes the supreme master again, he will become one of the four supreme masters. Who can compete with him?
The decline of Piaomiao Immortal Palace was caused by the Wujiang Immortal Sect stepping on its head. No matter how humiliating it is, it can only endure it.
"Okay! Let's let it go!"
Finally, Feijian spoke unscrupulously.
Li Yuan turned his eyes and looked at the Wanjie Palace.
"What about you?"
The Twelve Holy Pillars of the Palace of All Realms frowned. Are they going to step on all the transcendent forces?
Aren't you afraid that all parties will unite to kill the Wujiang Immortal Sect?
They can't do anything to Li Yuan, but in a big battle, the Wujiang Immortal Sect will never be able to hold on, and everyone except Li Yuan and Sword Fairy will probably die.
It will even bring disaster to the creatures in the Taichu Realm and once again give the Chaos Gods and Demons an opportunity to take advantage of it.
Li Yuan is so reckless?
But...
No one dares to bet with Li Yuan, and no one is willing to bet on whether a madman will die.
Not to mention that Li Yuan has had too many accidents, and no one knows if there will be another unpredictable thing waiting for them.
"I once relied on a pair of iron fists to forcibly fight my way through the Taichu Realm, establishing the only detachment without the inheritance background of the Immortal Lord."
"Everyone in the world says that I have the right time, place, and people. The pattern of the beginning is set. No one can repeat my miraculous path."
"Li Yuan, you did it."
"Not only did you do it, you did it better than me."
The Grand Master of the Palace of All Realms, Yang Zhuyang Wudi, suddenly laughed.
"It's just a super large fairy state, we will give it to you, the winner will get it, the loser will lose it, we accept it!"
In fact, the six transcendences have already weighed the pros and cons.
The battle for the Immortal Seed has been settled, and the future has been basically decided. The importance of the super-large Immortal Province is far less than it used to be.
In the past era, the six transcendences all relied on super-large immortal states to maintain their growth and attract many cultivation resources.
It also relies on the huge supernatural power, countless descendants and the movement of the fate of all living beings to maintain and slow down the decay of spiritual consciousness.
Today, none of that matters.
When Li Yuan becomes the emperor, the era will usher in a countdown to great destruction.
At that time, everything will be false. It will be enough to have a super-large fairy state to maintain their self-proclaimed sleep. Anyway, the chance of sleeping until the next era is very slim.
"Okay."
Li Yuan was rude.
He wants to build multiple super-large fairy states with only one purpose, which is to gather the fate of all living beings and perceive the origin of the world.
He has only one plan next.
That is to connect Taichu Realm to the Realm of Life and Death and Tianyuan Continent. This is the most critical step, related to whether the great world can be truly completed.
Li Yuan's eyes shifted again, this time aimed at the Hongmeng Spirit Clan.
The expressions of all the top cultivators of the Hongmeng Spirit Clan changed.
You must know that the entire Hongmeng Spirit Clan only occupies two very large fairy states, but it contains countless races. There are more wolves and less meat.
Let out another one?
Then the Hongmeng Spirit Clan is really going to be exhausted.
"You are one too."
Li Yuan's eyes were like fire, and he spoke directly to the Hongmeng Spirit Clan without any mercy.
"Venerable Li Yuan, do you have to force us?"
